items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: George -- Marie St. Louis called me up

ctx.x: George -- Marie St. Louis called me up and told me to be at such and such a place for her (inaudible) and she said, 'that's not CP time.' I said, what's that? (Laughs) I never heard that.
Yeah, we have a little inside joke like that, colored people --
